The '''H'ratth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the planet [[H'ratth]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book published in [[2009]], placed the H'ratth system in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> However, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], published on [[StarWars.com|the official ''Star Wars'' website]] after the release of the ''Atlas'', located the [[Star system/Legends|system]] (and consequently the planet) in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
